SELECT 
  date_trunc('hour', checked_at) + (floor(extract(minute from checked_at)/30)::int * interval '30 minute') AS interval_start,
  component,
  count(*) AS total_checks,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_healthy = false) AS unhealthy_checks,
  round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_healthy = false) / count(*), 2) AS unhealthy_rate_pct,
  round(avg(latency_ms)) AS avg_latency_ms
FROM system_health_checks
WHERE checked_at >= timestamp '2025-11-28 13:00:00' AND checked_at < timestamp '2025-11-28 17:00:00'
  AND component IN ('checkout','storefront')
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY interval_start ASC, component ASC
note: system_health_checks has no tenant filter requested, so this aggregates health checks across all tenants for the checkout/storefront components in the given window, as specified.
